title: AI-Assisted Engineering
description: Can use AI on real work while disclosing it and verifying the output — and can choose when not to generate code so the human stays accountable.

levels.name: Foundation
levels.description: Can complete a guided change with AI allowed, write a disclosure that names the tool, the purpose and what was independently checked, and mark which parts were generated — under written guidance.

levels.name: Apprentice
levels.description: Can commit a spec before any generated implementation, save the prompt as given, and list at least one concrete correction made to the output before treating it as theirs.

levels.name: Practitioner
levels.description: Can independently write tests that fail on a stub before requesting generation, keep those tests as the acceptance gate, and reject at least one suggestion with a stated reason.

levels.name: Journeyman
levels.description: Can diagnose a session that drifted or a case that should not be generated — isolate and revert the unwanted diff, or withhold generation for an irreversible, security-sensitive or still-unclear change — and keep a decision record written before the work.

levels.name: Mastery Evidence
levels.description: Can review another apprentice's AI-assisted change or review draft, name a defect or a comment the model missed, and teach when not to generate code on a problem they did not specify.
